phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Repo setup, team contracts, design system decisions, data file review, component wireframes.
milestones: All teams have GitHub access and can push to their branch
Shared design tokens agreed on (Team 1 leads)
Instructor data files reviewed and documented in /shared/data/
Team 3 match output format defined and agreed
All teams have initial wireframes or component sketches

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Core component development. Each team builds their piece. Weekly status updates required.
milestones: Components individually functional with sample data
Cross-team data contracts tested (Team 2 → Team 3 → Team 4 → Team 5)
Team 1 style guide published and all components compliant

phases.name: Integration
phases.description: Components wired together. End-to-end flow tested. Bugs surfaced and triaged.
milestones: Full user flow works start to finish

phases.name: Handoff
phases.description: Teams switch components. Outgoing team leaves component in a state the next team can trust.
milestones: All status.json files show complete or handoff_notes written
Each component runs locally with a fresh clone
Incoming team makes their first commit

phases.name: Second Component
phases.description: Teams build their second assigned component. Same rhythm as Phase 2.
